spans.s: A carriage, chariot, car, vehicle; especially, a war-chariot.
A hero (for रथिन्); अपवातेषु पार्येषु त्रयस्ते$भावञ् रथाः
The body; cf. आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु Kaṭh.
अङ्गम् any part of a carriage.
particularly, the wheels of a carriage; रथो रथाङ्गध्वनिना विजज्ञे
a discus, especially of Viṣṇu; चक्रधर
a potter's wheel. (-ङ्गः) the ruddy goose. ˚आह्वयः, ˚आह्वानः, ˚नामकः, ˚नामन् m. the ruddy goose (चक्रवाक); रथाङ्गनामन् वियुतो रथाङ्गश्रोणिबिम्बया । अयं त्वां पृच्छति रथी मनोरथशतैर्वृतः ॥

; रथाङ्गाह्वानानां भवति विधुरम् Udb.; (the male bird is said by poets to be separated from the female at night, and to be united at sun-rise). ˚पाणिः N. of Viṣṇu; रथाङ्गपाणेः पटलेन रोचिषा Śi.1.21; दुरन्तवीर्यस्य रथाङ्गपाणेः Bhāg. -अभ्रः a reed cane. -अर्थकः a small carriage. -अश्वः a carriage-horse -आयुधकः a kind of bow. -आरोहः one who fights from a chariot.-ईशः a warrior fighting from a chariot. -ईषा, -शा the pole of a carriage; रथेषाश्च रथेषाभिः ... संगतैः सहिताः
. -उडुपः, -पम् the body of a chariot.-उद्वहः, -उपस्थः the seat of a chariot, the driving-box; रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्
. -कट्या, -कड्या an assemblage of chariots. -कल्पकः an officer who is in charge of a king's chariots.
करः, कारः a coachbuilder, carpenter, wheel-wright; रथकारः स्वकां भार्यां सजारां शिरसा- वहत्
N. of a caste called सौधन्वन (q. v.); तस्मादत्रैवर्णिको रथकारः ŚB. on
; परिशेषाद- त्रैवर्णिको रथकारः स्यात् ŚB. on
. ˚न्यायः The rule according to which the रूढ अर्थ is stronger than the यौगिक अर्थ; cf. योगाद्रूढिर्बलीयसी. This is discussed and established in connection with the word रथकार by Jaimini and शबर in
-5. -सुटुम्बिकः, -कुटुम्बिन्m. a charioteer, coachman. -कूबरः, -रम् the pole or shaft of a carriage; कूबरा रथकूबरैः ... संगतैः सहिताः
. -केतुः the flag of a chariot. -क्षोभः the jolting of a chariot; रथक्षोभपरिश्रमम्

. -गणकः an officer who counts chariots. -गर्भकः a litter, palanquin. -गुप्तिःf. a fence of wood or iron with which a chariot is provided as a protection from collision. -घोषः the rattling of a chariot.
the सुदर्शन wheel; रथाङ्गे चन्द्रार्कौ रथचरणपाणिः शर इति Śivamahimna 18.
the ruddy goose. -चर्या chariot-exercise, the use of a chariot, travelling by carriage; अनभ्यस्त- रथचर्याः
.-जङ्घा the hinder part of a chariot. -ज्वरः a crow.-दुर्गम् the throng of chariots. -धुर् f. the shaft or pole of a chariot. -नाभिः f. the nave of the wheel of a chariot; रथनाभिरिवाभिख्यायेत Ait.
. -नीडः the inner part or seat of a chariot. -पुंगवः a chief or distinguished warrior.
बन्धः the fastenings or harness of a chariot.

-यात्रा the solemn procession of an idol placed in a car (usually drawn by men). -मुखम् the forepart of a carriage. -युद्धम् 'a chariot-fight', a fight between combatants mounted on chariots. -योगः a team (of horses etc.) on a chariot; Bri. Up. -योजकः a charioteer, harnesser of a chariot. -वंशः a number of chariots.-वर्त्मन् n., -वीथिः f. highway, main road. -वारकः son of a Śūdra and a Sairandhrī.
charioteer. -विज्ञानम्, -विद्या the art of driving chariots. -शक्तिः f. the staff which supports the banner of a war-chariot; रथशक्तिं मुमोचासौ दीप्तामग्नि- शिखामिव
. -शाला a coach-house, carriageshed. -शास्त्रम्, -शिक्षा the art of driving a chariot, coachmanship. -सप्तमी the seventh day in the bright half of Māgha.
रथन्तरम् [rathantaram], A Vedic Sāma; स्वरादीविशेषानुपूर्वीमात्रस्वरूपे ऋगक्षरव्यतिरिक्तं यद् गानं तद् रथन्तरम् । (सामर्चिकभाष्यम्); एतद्रथन्तरमग्नौ प्रोतम् Ch.
(com. रथो मायारूपो विग्रहः तं तरत्यनेन तद्रथन्तरम् । 'अहं ब्रह्मास्मि'
रथारथि [rathārathi], ind. 'Chariot against chariot', in closest fight.
The owner of a carriage. -कः A cartwright.
Riding or driving in a carriage.
A warrior who fights from a chariot; आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु । बुद्धिं तु सारथिं विद्धि मनः प्रग्रहमेव च ॥ Kaṭha
A driver. -नी A number of carriages or chariots.
A chariot-horse; धावन्त्यमी मृगजवाक्षमयेव रथ्याः Ś.1.8; Śi.4.14.
A part of a chariot. -Comp. -चयः a team of horses. -विरथ्यः N. of Śiva.
रथ्या [rathyā], 1 A road for carriages; (hence) a high-way, main road; भूयो भूयः सविधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटन्तम्
A place where many roads meet.

A number of carriages or chariots; रथ्याघोषैर्बृंहणैर्वारणानाम् Śi.18.3; अश्वीयैरौक्षकैर्मानुष्यकै रथ्याभिरौष्ट्रकैः Dharmābhyudaya-Mahākāvyam 2.26. -Comp. -पङ्क्तिः a row of streets.-मुखम् entrance to a road. -मृगः a dog.
